summary: The rebound is gathering pace, with the Sensex now up about 600 pts as tech-led buying spreads, though the market is still trying to dodge a ninth straight weekly loss.

detail.leaders: IT (Nifty IT +2.8–3%): TCS, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, HCL Tech
detail.tone: Firmer than the open: the Sensex gain widened to about 600 pts per the latest headline, after Nifty was at 22,353.60 (+121.80) at 9:18 am.
watch: Whether the week can avoid a ninth straight weekly fall
